proposition.name: QuantumMachineLawfulAndConserved
proposition.text:
CircuitLinearAndAcyclic spec :=
  DistinctGateWires spec.steps = true
  /\ KahnTopologicalAcyclic spec.steps = true

PhaseOctantFusionIdentity a b :=
  phaseOctantFusionMod8 a b = (a + b) % 8
  /\ phaseOctantFusionMod8 a (8 - (a % 8)) = 0

ConservationLedgerValid state :=
  exactNormSquared Z[sqrt 2] state.support = state.normDenom
proposition.plain: Every admitted quantum circuit satisfies wire-linearity (no-cloning) and Kahn DAG acyclicity, diagonal Z₈ phase gates fuse losslessly modulo 8 with exact involution cancellation, and sparse cyclotomic probability mass equals 1 identically without floating-point drift.
